# C03 design: Entitlements, plans and feature flags

Covers ADMIN04 (feature flags per organisation) and the admin side of BILL01 and BILL02 (per-organisation limit overrides on the pilot plan), plus NFR23, NFR24 and NFR27 for every new screen. ADMIN05 and NFR04 (the usage meter) have no screen in C03: the usage report belongs to C18.

Surfaces:

1. Flags and limits page: `/admin/organisations/[organisationId]`
2. The **All** tab on `/admin/organisations`
3. Organisation names on the **Decided** tab link to the flags and limits page

## Rules for the whole chunk

- **D01, D02, C01 and C02 rules still apply.** Use tokens only, through `var(--token)` or the token-mapped Tailwind utilities. Use spacing steps 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8 and 12 only. Set text with the type classes only (`heading-1`, `heading-2`, `body-lg`, `body`, `body-strong`, `label`, `caption`, `data`, `eyebrow`). Lucide icons go through `iconProps`, are `aria-hidden`, and always sit next to a word. The focus ring is the global `:focus-visible` rule.
- **Theme.** No C03 surface is forced dark. Both pages follow the system setting.
- **Who.** Wideline staff (`platform_admin` in the platform organisation), mostly on a desktop, now and then on a phone. Admin is "data-dense tables" in the design system's table of users.
- **One primary button per view.** The flags and limits page has 9 forms, so none of their buttons is primary. Every Save is `secondary`; every **Use plan default** is `ghost`.
- **No confirmation dialogs.** Every change is reversible and audited, so it saves on submit.
- **Server action results, field errors, banners, pending labels, phone card lists and touch sizes:** as in C01 ("Rules for the whole chunk"). Reuse `useFormAction`, `Field`, `SubmitButton`, `FormBusy`, `useFocusFirstInvalid`, `Banner`, `SuccessBanner`, `FormErrorBanner` and `fieldError` from `components/forms.tsx`.
- **Chips are for states only.** A flag's effective state (On or Off) is a chip. The source of a value ("From a flag") is `caption` text, never a chip. A limit value is text, never a chip.
- **Dates.** `formatDate()` from `lib/labels.ts` ("24 Oct 2026").
- **Numbers.** Numerals with a unit, grouped with commas and a full stop for decimals: "10,000 clips", "8.59 GB" (`Intl.NumberFormat("en-GB")`). This is the app's first number formatter (Q-007). Add to `lib/labels.ts`:
  - `formatCount(n)`: `Intl.NumberFormat("en-GB", { maximumFractionDigits: 0 })`.
  - `formatGB(bytes)`: bytes / 1,000,000,000 with `maximumFractionDigits: 2`, then " GB" ("8.59 GB", "10 GB"). Decimal GB, as the plan says; never GiB.
  - `limitText(key, value)`: "Unlimited" for Infinity; `formatGB` for `unit: 'bytes'`; otherwise `formatCount` plus the unit noun from the table below ("1 match", "100 matches").
- **Copy.** Sentence case, British and South African spelling, no exclamation marks, no emoji. All key labels and descriptions below are draft: mark them in `src/lib/entitlement-keys.ts` with `// Draft copy`.

### Labels for the registry, `src/lib/entitlement-keys.ts`

Every key carries `label` and `description`. Limits also carry the unit noun (singular, plural); features carry `release`.

**Limits**

| Key | Label | Description | Unit |
|---|---|---|---|
| `matches_per_month` | Matches per month | Matches this organisation can upload in a calendar month. | match, matches |
| `favourited_clips` | Favourited clips | Clips kept beyond 14 days because someone favourited them. | clip, clips |
| `member_seats` | Member seats | Owners, admins and coaches in this organisation. Players and guardians never count. | seat, seats |
| `scout_seats` | Scout seats | Scouts and agents in this organisation. | seat, seats |
| `upload_max_bytes` | Largest upload | The biggest single match video this organisation can upload. | bytes, shown in GB |

**Features**

| Key | Label | Description | Release |
|---|---|---|---|
| `billing` | Billing | Shows plans and payment pages to this organisation. Leave off until paid plans start. | v2 |
| `scout_search` | Scout search | Lets scouts search players across every club, not only the matches they review. | v1 |
| `share_links` | Share links | Lets players and guardians share a public link to their profile. | v1 |
| `scout_reports` | Scout reports | Lets scouts write reports on players. | v1 |

**Sources** (`ENTITLEMENT_SOURCE_LABELS` in `lib/labels.ts`, keyed by `EntitlementSource`):

| Source | Text |
|---|---|
| `default` | Built-in default |
| `plan` | From the {plan name} plan ("From the Pilot plan") |
| `override` | From an override |
| `flag` | From a flag |

**Subscription status** (shown only when not active): Active, Past due, Cancelled, Lapsed.

### Chip preset: `FLAG_STATES` in `components/ui/StatusChip.tsx`

Export `FlagStateChip({ on }: { on: boolean })` from `components/ui/index.ts`. Not added to the gallery: it is an admin-only preset, and adding it would move the screenshot baselines for no user-facing gain.

| State | Tone | Icon | Copy |
|---|---|---|---|
| on | ok | `Check` | On |
| off | neutral | `CircleOff` | Off |

`neutral` is the README's tone for "inactive". The word and the icon carry the state, so it never rests on colour.

### CSS: append to the "Additions (not in bundle.css)" block in `web/src/styles/components.css`

Not in the design system; built from tokens. Start with `/* Flags and limits for C03 (docs/build/design/C03.md). Not in the design system; built from tokens. */`

| Rule | Spec |
|---|---|
| `.wl-setting` | One setting card: added to a `wl-card`. `display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--space-4)`. From 1280px: `display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 5fr) minmax(0, 7fr); gap: var(--space-6); align-items: start`. The left column holds what the setting is and its current value; the right column holds the form. |
| `.wl-setting__facts` | The plan, override and effective values of a limit: a `dl`. `display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: var(--space-2)`. From 768px: `grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: var(--space-4)`. Each `div` holds `dt.label.text-ink-muted` and `dd` (value in `data`, then the source in `caption text-ink-muted` on its own line). |
| `.wl-choice-row` | The three flag radios. `display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--space-1)`. From 768px: `flex-direction: row; flex-wrap: wrap; column-gap: var(--space-6); row-gap: var(--space-1)`. Each child is the existing `.wl-choice` (40px rows, 44px under 768px). |

### Deviation from the plan, on purpose

- **PageHeader plus sections, not DetailPage.** DetailPage's hero sets the title in `display-xl`, which the design system keeps for player names and big numbers. C02's `/scout` made the same call.
- **Each card keeps its own result.** The plan names `useSectionAction` and a section banner. Cards never unmount after a save (unlike approved rows), so each card uses `useFormAction` and shows its banner inside the card, next to the control that changed. Focus stays on the Save button. Jumping to a section heading would lose the admin's place among 9 cards. C02's **Save match** does the same.
- **The limit form is one form with two submit buttons.** **Save** and **Use plan default** share the reason field, so a clear is audited with its reason too. Save submits to `setLimitOverrideAction`; **Use plan default** carries `formAction={clearLimitOverrideAction}`. Give `SubmitButton` a `formAction` prop; the `useFormAction` `onSubmit` picks the dispatch from `submitter`. Without JavaScript the native `formaction` attribute does the same.
- **Who set it and when.** Under a flag or override, the page shows "Set on {date} by {name}". `getOrganisationEntitlements` adds `updatedAt`, `reason` and the setter's name (one `User` lookup by the `setByUserId` values) to each flag and override.
- **Status nav label.** The three tabs are no longer all statuses, so the nav's `aria-label` changes from "Application status" to "Organisation list". No test uses the old label.

## Surface 1: flags and limits page, `/admin/organisations/[organisationId]`

**Who, where, job.** Used by Wideline staff (`platform_admin`), on a desktop, now and then on a phone. One job: turn a feature on or off, or raise or lower a limit, for one organisation, with a record of why.

**Access.** `requirePageRole(PLATFORM_ROLES)` first, then `getOrganisationEntitlements(ctx, organisationId)`; `notFound()` on `EntitlementAdminError('not_found')`. Every action calls `requireRole(PLATFORM_ROLES)` first, then `revalidatePath("/admin/organisations/{id}")` and `revalidatePath("/admin/organisations")`. Metadata title: **Flags and limits · {organisation name}** (the layout appends " · Wideline").

### Structure (DOM order = visual order = tab order)

1. `PageHeader`:
   - back: `{ href: "/admin/organisations?status=all", label: "All organisations" }` (read as "Back to All organisations").
   - eyebrow: **Flags and limits**.
   - title: the organisation name.
   - intro (ReactNode, `body text-ink-muted mt-2 max-w-prose`): **On the {plan name} plan. Changes apply straight away and are recorded in the audit log.** When the subscription is not active: **On the {plan name} plan ({status, lower case}). Changes apply straight away and are recorded in the audit log.**
2. `div.wl-row.mt-3`: `OrganisationStatusChip`, then `span.caption.text-ink-muted` **{type label} · {location}** (C01 location rule; a missing part is left out).
3. Partial-data banners, each `mt-4`, only when they apply (see States).
4. `AdminNav current="organisations"` (`mt-6`, as on the list).
5. `FlagsSection.tsx` (client): `section.mt-8` with `aria-labelledby` its h2.
   - `h2.heading-2` **Feature flags**.
   - `p.body.text-ink-muted.mt-2.max-w-prose`: **Turn a feature on or off for this organisation only. A flag beats the plan and any override.**
   - `p.caption.text-ink-muted.mt-2`: **No flags set. Every feature follows the plan.** or **{n} of 4 features set by a flag.** (**1 of 4 features set by a flag.**)
   - `ul role="list" class="mt-4 flex flex-col gap-3"`, one flag card per feature, in registry order.
6. `LimitsSection.tsx` (client): `section.mt-8`, same pattern.
   - `h2.heading-2` **Limits**.
   - Intro: **Raise or lower a limit for this organisation only. Limits are recorded now and enforced once paid plans start in v2.**
   - Summary: **No overrides. Every limit follows the plan.** or **{n} of 5 limits overridden.** (**1 of 5 limits overridden.**)
   - `ul role="list" class="mt-4 flex flex-col gap-3"`, one limit card per limit, in registry order.

### Flag card

`li.wl-card.wl-setting` with `aria-labelledby` its h3.

Left column (`div.flex.flex-col.gap-2`):
1. `h3.body-strong` the label (**Scout search**).
2. `p.body.text-ink-muted` the description.
3. `p.caption.text-ink-muted` **Release: {release}** ("Release: v1").
4. `div.wl-row`: `FlagStateChip` for the effective value, then `span.caption.text-ink-muted` the source text ("From a flag", "From the Pilot plan", "Built-in default").
5. When a flag row exists: `p.caption.text-ink-muted` **Set on {date} by {name}.** (no name found: **Set on {date}.**), and when it has a reason, `p.body` **Reason: {reason}** (`break-words`).

Right column: `form.flex.flex-col.gap-4` with `noValidate`, `FormBusy` and hidden `organisationId` and `key`.
1. Banner slot `div[aria-live="polite"]`: `SuccessBanner`.
2. `fieldset.wl-field` with `legend.label` **Setting** plus `span.sr-only` **for {label}**. Inside it, `div.wl-choice-row` with three `label.wl-choice.body` radios, `name="state"`:

   | Value | Label |
   |---|---|
   | `default` | **Plan default (Off)** or **Plan default (On)**, from the plan's value |
   | `on` | **On** |
   | `off` | **Off** |

   Checked: `default` when there is no flag row, else `on` or `off` from the row. Always exactly one checked, so there is no "nothing chosen" error.
3. `Field` **Reason (optional)** plus `span.sr-only` **for {label}**: `input name="reason" maxLength={500} autoComplete="off"`, hint **Kept in the audit log. Say who asked and why.** Widen `Field`'s `label` prop to `ReactNode` for the hidden suffix.
4. `FormErrorBanner`.
5. Actions, `div.wl-row`: `SubmitButton variant="secondary"` **Save** (`aria-label="Save {label}"`, pending **Saving…**). Under 768px it is `block` (full width, 48px).

### Limit card

`li.wl-card.wl-setting` with `aria-labelledby` its h3.

Left column (`div.flex.flex-col.gap-3`):
1. `h3.body-strong` the label (**Matches per month**).
2. `p.body.text-ink-muted` the description.
3. `dl.wl-setting__facts`:

   | dt | dd |
   |---|---|
   | **Plan** | `limitText` of the plan value in `data`. When the plan lacks the key: the registry fallback, with `caption text-ink-muted` **Built-in default** under it |
   | **Override** | `limitText` of the override in `data`, or **None** in `body text-ink-muted` |
   | **Now** | `limitText` of the effective value in `data`, with the source text in `caption text-ink-muted` under it |

4. When an override row exists: **Set on {date} by {name}.** and **Reason: {reason}**, as on the flag card.

Right column: `form.flex.flex-col.gap-4`, `noValidate`, `FormBusy`, hidden `organisationId` and `key`.
1. Banner slot `div[aria-live="polite"]`: `SuccessBanner`.
2. Value row, `div.flex.flex-col.gap-2.md:flex-row.md:items-start.md:gap-4`:
   - `Field` (`md:flex-1`) **New limit** for counts, **New limit in GB** for bytes; `span.sr-only` **for {label}** after either.
     - Counts: `input type="number" name="value" inputMode="numeric" min={0} step={1}`.
     - Bytes: `input type="number" name="value" inputMode="decimal" min={0} step={0.01}`; the server multiplies by 1,000,000,000 and rounds to a whole byte.
     - Prefilled with the override when it is a number (bytes shown in GB, 2 decimals at most); empty otherwise. No placeholder.
     - Hint: **Plan default: {limitText of plan value}.** ("Plan default: 100 matches.")
   - `label.wl-choice.body` with `input type="checkbox" name="unlimited" value="yes"`: **Unlimited**. From 768px it sits beside the input with `md:mt-6`, lining up with the 40px input under its label. Checked when the override is `'unlimited'`. With JavaScript, ticking it disables the number input and keeps its value; unticking enables it again. Without JavaScript both submit, and Unlimited wins.
3. `Field` **Reason (optional)**, exactly as on the flag card. One reason serves both buttons.
4. `FormErrorBanner`.
5. Actions, `div.wl-row`, Save first so Enter in any field saves:
   - `SubmitButton variant="secondary"` **Save** (`aria-label="Save {label}"`, pending **Saving…**).
   - `SubmitButton variant="ghost"` **Use plan default** (`aria-label="Use plan default for {label}"`, pending **Clearing…**, `formAction={clearLimitOverrideAction}`). Rendered only when an override row exists. A clear ignores the value and the Unlimited box.
   - Under 768px both are `block` (full width, 48px), stacked with `space-2`.

After a successful clear, the form shows the new server values: key the value row on `{source}-{effective}` so it remounts empty, while the card's result state survives.

### Layout

| | 375 | 768 | 1280 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Header | Back link, eyebrow, title (wraps), intro, chip and type line | Same, wider | Same |
| AdminNav | Full width | Inline | Inline |
| Cards | One column: what, current value, then the form, all stacked | Stacked like 375. Flag radios in one row; the limit facts in 3 columns; the number input and Unlimited side by side | `.wl-setting` grid: 5 parts info left, 7 parts form right |
| Buttons | Full width, 48px | Auto width, 40px | Same as 768 |
| Inputs | 44px (C01 rule) | 40px | 40px |

No horizontal scroll at any width: no tables on this page.

### States and copy

**Success banners** (`wl-banner--ok`, `role="status"`, in the card):

| Change | Copy |
|---|---|
| Flag on | **{label} is on for {organisation}.** |
| Flag off | **{label} is off for {organisation}.** |
| Flag back to plan default | **{label} follows the {plan name} plan again: {On or Off}.** |
| Override saved | **{label} is now {limitText} for {organisation}.** ("Matches per month is now 250 matches for Wideline Demo FC.", "Largest upload is now unlimited for …") |
| Override cleared | **{label} follows the {plan name} plan again: {limitText}.** |
| Nothing changed (same state, or a clear with no override) | **Nothing changed. {label} was already {On, Off, the plan default, or limitText}.** Same `ok` banner; no row and no audit are written. |

**Field errors** (under the field, `aria-invalid`, focus moves to the first one):

| Case | Copy (field) |
|---|---|
| Save with no number and Unlimited not ticked | **Enter a whole number, or tick Unlimited.** (value) |
| Count not a whole number of 0 or more | **Enter a whole number of 0 or more.** (value) |
| Count over 1,000,000,000 | **Use 1,000,000,000 or less.** (value) |
| GB below 0 or not a number | **Enter a size in GB of 0 or more, for example 8.5.** (value) |
| GB over 10,000 | **Use 10,000 GB or less.** (value) |
| Reason over 500 characters | **Use 500 characters or fewer.** (reason) |

**Form errors** (`wl-banner--danger`, `role="alert"`, above the actions):

| Case | Copy |
|---|---|
| Organisation deleted meanwhile (`not_found`) | **This organisation no longer exists.** |
| Unknown key, or a feature key sent as a limit (tampered or stale page) | **This setting no longer exists. Reload the page.** |
| Unexpected | **Something went wrong. Try again.** |

**Page states:**

| State | Behaviour and copy |
|---|---|
| Loading | Inherited `(app)/loading.tsx` (`ListSkeleton`). Pending labels and `aria-busy` on each form. |
| Error | Inherited `(app)/error.tsx` (`ErrorState`). |
| Forbidden | Every non-platform role, including a club owner, goes to `/forbidden`. |
| Not found | `notFound()` renders `(app)/not-found.tsx`: **Page not found**. |
| Empty | The registry is never empty. "No flags set" and "No overrides" are the empty states, in each section's summary line. |
| Organisation not active (pending, rejected, suspended) | `Banner tone="warn"` under the header: **{organisation} is not active. Changes are saved and apply if it becomes active.** The forms still work. |
| No subscription (BILL02 fallback) | `Banner tone="warn"`: **{organisation} has no plan, so it uses the Pilot plan's limits.** The intro reads **No plan. Uses the Pilot plan. Changes apply straight away and are recorded in the audit log.** With no Pilot plan row either: **{organisation} has no plan, so it uses built-in defaults.**, and each source reads **Built-in default**. |
| Stored value not valid (resolver skipped it) | In that card, under the facts: `p.wl-inline-status.wl-inline-status--warn.caption` with `TriangleAlert` **The stored {override or flag} is not valid, so it is ignored. Save a new value or use the plan default.** For an invalid flag, saving any choice replaces it. The facts show **Not valid** in `body text-ink-muted` for that layer. |
| A flag row on a limit key (not set through this UI) | Source reads **From a flag**. Under the facts, `wl-inline-status--warn` `TriangleAlert`: **A flag sets this limit, so an override has no effect while it is set.** |
| Long content | Organisation names and reasons wrap (`break-words`). A 500-character reason wraps in the left column. |
| Small sample | 4 flags and 5 limits; nothing extra. |
| Reads | Not cached: a save shows the new effective value on the re-render. |

### Keyboard and screen readers

- Tab order: skip link and shell, back link, AdminNav links, then per flag card: the radio group (one Tab stop; arrow keys move and select, native), Reason, Save. Then per limit card: New limit, Unlimited, Reason, Save, Use plan default.
- Enter in a text or number field submits Save (the first submit button in DOM order). No shortcuts.
- After a save, focus stays on the button that submitted, which is enabled again; the card's `aria-live` slot announces the banner. On a field error, focus moves to the first invalid field (`useFocusFirstInvalid`). After a clear, **Use plan default** unmounts, so move focus to the card's Save button.
- Each card is a list item named by its h3. Every control's accessible name includes the setting: "Setting for Scout search", "Reason (optional) for Scout search", "New limit for Matches per month", "Save Scout search", "Use plan default for Matches per month". The Unlimited checkbox gets `aria-describedby` pointing at the card's h3 id, so it is read as "Unlimited, Matches per month".
- Chips and inline statuses have words; every icon is `aria-hidden`.
- The page has one h1 (the organisation name), h2s for the two sections, h3s per card.

## Surface 2: the **All** tab on `/admin/organisations`

**Who, where, job.** Wideline staff, mostly on a desktop. One job: find any organisation, including the seeded ones that never applied, and open its flags and limits.

**Access.** Unchanged page guard. `listAllOrganisations(ctx)` calls `assertPlatformAdmin`.

### Structure

The page keeps its header, title **Organisation applications** and intro, and `AdminNav`.

1. `<nav aria-label="Organisation list" class="wl-tabs mt-6">`, three links in this order:
   - **Pending** plus the count in `data` (`?status=pending`, the default).
   - **Decided** (`?status=decided`).
   - **All** (`?status=all`).
   Any other `status` value falls back to Pending.
2. On the All tab only, `p.body.text-ink-muted.mt-4.max-w-prose`: **Every organisation on Wideline, including Wideline's own. Open one to change its flags and limits.**
3. `OrganisationsTable.tsx` (server component) at `mt-6`: a `section` with an `sr-only` h2 **Organisations**, then `DataTable` with `cards`.

### Table

Caption (`sr-only`, also the region's `aria-label`): **All organisations, by name**. Rows sorted by name, case-insensitive.

| Column | Content |
|---|---|
| Organisation | `Link href="/admin/organisations/{id}" class="body-strong text-pitch underline"` with the name; then `span.caption.block.text-ink-muted` **{type label} · {location}**. Type labels include **Wideline platform** and **Scout network**. |
| Status | `OrganisationStatusChip`. |
| Plan | The plan name in `body` (**Pilot**). With no subscription: `span.wl-inline-status.wl-inline-status--warn.caption` `TriangleAlert` **No plan, uses Pilot**. |

No action column: the name link is the way in. The link is underlined, so it never relies on colour alone.

### Cards (under 768px)

`li.wl-card.flex.flex-col.gap-2` per organisation, no `id` attributes:
1. `div.flex.items-start.justify-between.gap-3`: the name link (`body-strong text-pitch underline min-w-0 break-words`) and the status chip.
2. `p.caption.text-ink-muted` **{type label} · {location}**.
3. `p.caption.text-ink-muted` **Plan: Pilot**, or the warning inline status.

### Layout

| | 375 | 768 | 1280 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Tabs | Full width; scroll sideways if needed | Inline | Inline |
| Rows | Cards | Table in its focusable scroll region | Table, all columns visible |

### States and copy

| State | Behaviour and copy |
|---|---|
| Empty | `body-lg text-ink-muted mt-6`: **No organisations yet.** (Unreachable in practice: the platform organisation always exists.) |
| Loading | Inherited `ListSkeleton`. |
| Forbidden | Every non-platform role goes to `/forbidden`. |
| Partial data | No subscription: the warning inline status above. A missing region shows the country only. |
| Long content | Names wrap; the table scrolls inside its region. |
| Many rows | No pagination in v0 (pilot target is 5 clubs). |
| Small sample | One row; nothing extra. |

### Keyboard and screen readers

- Tab order: AdminNav links, the three list links, the table region (focusable so it can scroll), then one organisation link per row.
- The current tab has `aria-current="page"` and the `pitch` bar plus darker word (existing `.wl-tabs` rule).
- Link text is the organisation name. Screen readers hear it inside the captioned table, so no extra label is needed.
- No shortcuts.

## Surface 3: Decided tab links

**Who, where, job.** Same staff, same page. One job: go from a decision straight to that organisation's flags and limits.

- In `Applications.tsx`, on the Decided tab only, the organisation name becomes `Link href="/admin/organisations/{id}" class="body-strong text-pitch underline"`, in the table cell and on the phone card. Pending rows keep plain text: a pending organisation is decided first.
- Nothing else in the row changes. No separate "Flags and limits" link is needed, because the name is the link.
- Keyboard: the link joins the tab order before the row's **Resend owner invitation** button. On the phone card it sits before the chip.

## Accessibility checks for the builder

- Run axe (wcag2a/aa, 21aa, 22aa) with zero violations at 375, 768 and 1280 on `/admin/organisations/{Wideline Demo FC}` with one flag set and one override set, after a success banner, and with a field error showing. Run it on `/admin/organisations?status=all` too.
- No horizontal scroll on the flags and limits page at 375, 768 and 1280.
- Keyboard path at 1280: set **Scout search** to On, save, set **Matches per month** to 250 with a reason, save, then **Use plan default**, all with Tab, arrow keys, Space and Enter only. Focus lands on Save after each save, and on Save after the clear.
- Never colour alone: the flag chip has a word and an icon; each source and warning has words; links are underlined.
- Touch: every radio row, checkbox row, input and button is at least 44px tall under 768px.
- e2e selectors: on the All tab, pick the visible version (table from 768px, cards under). The effective flag reads the chip **On** and the caption **From a flag**; the effective limit reads **250 matches** and **From an override**.
